## Upload to Claude or ChatGPT

Download the ZIP for your app from the assets below, then upload it:

- **Claude**: in [Customize > Plugins](https://claude.ai/customize/plugins),
  select **Add** > **Upload plugin** and choose the `-claude.zip` file.
- **ChatGPT**: in [Skills](https://chatgpt.com/skills), select **Create** >
  **Upload from your computer** and choose the `-chatgpt.zip` file.
